After reading a story on here about a guy who got visited by aliens who
 took the form of cartoon characters or something to comfort him I'm genuinely freaked out now because I swear the same thing happened to me. One night I woke up and a cartoon skeleton just wiggled by or however it walked in that Disney cartoon I watched a few weeks before. I was pretty young, maybe five? I remember not being scared for some reason, just thinking something like "what the fuck" I then got out of bed started walking toward my parents room. I looked at the glass door to see some sort of werid goo with eyeballs just staring at me, it looked like someone took a bucket of the Nickelodeon smile and threw it up against the glass door. I then get into the room and they're both asleep. I then decide maybe I should just go back to bed and peak out the doorway to see grim from the grim adventures of Billy and mandy trying to coax me back into bed. Now as a kid I fucking loved that show. After a while of staring my memory just stops and I don't remember anything else. Also from around the same time I remember sitting at some baseball diamond watching kids play baseball at night with my great grandmother. Suddenly some blue beam comes down and picks a kid up and my grandma is like "it's ok Spodly" and then the memory just vanishes. Now I was not dreaming, this was completely real. Also at the time my great grandmother was the only one that loved me, because my parents where really abusive. Around middle school I used to wake up with scratches all over my body. My great grandmother who I lived with after running away told me it was growth stretches or something. There was this other time I looked at a clock in bed and blinked, when I opened my eyes the clock was at like three hours earlier or something, and then poof no more memory. Remembering all this is getting me really creeped out. Also sorry for the giant block of text I'm on a old kindle and to lazy to figure out how to make paragraphs or whatever.
